# Compixor AI - Full Documentation

> Free, 100% private document and media processing toolkit running in client-side RAM with zero permanent storage.

Compixor AI (https://compixor-ai.cloud) is a modern web application providing private, client-side document and media processing utilities.

## Core Architecture & Privacy Principles

1. **Client-Side First**: Utilities such as PDF compression, merge/split, watermarking, password encryption/decryption, DOCX image optimization, QR code generation, and biometric photo canvas rendering execute entirely in the user's browser using WebAssembly, Web Workers, and HTML5 Canvas APIs.
2. **Zero Permanent Retention**: No user file buffers, processed documents, or personal images are ever stored on persistent server disks.
3. **Zero Artificial Friction**: No account creation, no sign-ups, no subscription paywalls, no artificial file size traps, and zero platform watermarks stamped onto user files.

## Tools Directory

### 1. PDF Compressor
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/pdf-compressor
- **Capabilities**: Client-side vector stream downscaling, image resampling, and structural deduplication. Target sizes include 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB, or custom quality settings.

### 2. PDF Merge & Split
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/pdf-organizer
- **Capabilities**: Drag-and-drop page reorganization, multi-file merging into a single PDF, page rotation, and extraction of custom page ranges.

### 3. Add Watermark
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/add-watermark
- **Capabilities**: Stamp customizable vector text or PNG logo overlays across all or selected page ranges with rotation, opacity, and positioning controls.

### 4. Remove Watermark
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/remove-watermark
- **Capabilities**: Digital stream text/image deletion combined with interactive visual bounding box stamp eraser for clean document output.

### 5. Protect PDF
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/protect-pdf
- **Capabilities**: In-browser AES-256 password encryption with customizable user/owner passwords and granular permissions (print, copy, edit).

### 6. Unlock PDF
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/unlock-pdf
- **Capabilities**: Client-side decryption to strip passwords and permissions from owned PDF files without server uploads.

### 7. Word Compressor
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/word-compressor
- **Capabilities**: In-memory inspection of .docx ZIP archives, extracting and re-compressing high-resolution embedded images while preserving XML layout and typography.

### 8. Biometric Passport Photo Maker
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/passport-photo
- **Capabilities**: Precise biometric cropping presets (Pakistan NADRA 35x45mm, US Visa 2x2", UK/Schengen), portrait AI background removal, and 300 DPI high-resolution printable sheets (A4, A5, A6).

### 9. Full DP Maker
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/full-dp-maker
- **Capabilities**: Generate 1:1 aspect ratio square avatars for WhatsApp, Instagram, and LinkedIn with aesthetic gaussian blur backgrounds and no forced cropping.

### 10. Vector QR Code Generator
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/qr-generator
- **Capabilities**: Permanent static QR codes for URLs, WiFi networks, WhatsApp chat links, and vCards with vector SVG and 4K PNG exports.

### 11. PDF to Word Converter
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/pdf-to-word
- **Capabilities**: In-memory document parsing converting digital and scanned PDFs to editable Microsoft Word (.docx) documents with OCR support.

### 12. Image to Word Converter
- **URL**: https://compixor-ai.cloud/tools/img-to-word
- **Capabilities**: Extract text and tabular structures from JPG, PNG, WEBP, and scanned documents into editable .docx files with multi-language OCR.
